programme.desc: Heartbroken, Kubra pulls away. Emir intensifies his search for evidence, and Kubra vows never to return to Yigit.

programme.title: Matter Of Respect
programme.sub-title: S01 : E52 Matter Of Respect ep.052
programme.desc: Selim delivers explosive information to Emir about a money-filled car. Meanwhile, Sibel and Yigit prepare for their wedding, each carrying heavy secrets.

programme.title: Matter Of Respect
programme.sub-title: S01 : E49 Matter Of Respect ep.049
programme.desc: When Yigit announces he plans to flee the country with Kubra and her daughter, Emir confronts him — and the brothers erupt into a violent fight.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Alors que les autres se lancent à la recherche d'un détenu, Swarek parle à Andy de ses exploits. Alors qu'ils se lancent à la poursuite d'un informateur danger, et une étincelle jaillit.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy doit enfreindre le protocole afin de gagner la confiance d'une victime qui a été déçue par le système, alors que les autres recrues s'affrontent pour une cause lors de la "Fite Nite".

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy se fait passer pour une prostituée. La tension monte lorsque Dov met la vie d'une informatrice en danger et qu'Andy doit infiltrer un réseau de trafic d'armes pour la sauver.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Un cambriolage dans un quartier huppé mobilise toutes les jeunes recrues, mais une fois la scène inspectée, Andy se retrouve seule face à un voleur caché, armé et particulièrement instable.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Une collision mortelle révèle une vérité choquante, et la romance entre Andy et l'inspecteur Luke Callaghan se complique lorsqu'ils sont en désaccord sur la manière de traiter un témoin.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Une vague de chaleur fait des ravages, sans compter la présence d'un violeur en série. Dans ce chaos, une panne de courant générale force Andy à s'attaquer seule à ce dangereux prédateur.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy et Chris enquêtent sur une agression, mais quand tous les indices mènent à un policier, ils doivent prendre une décision qui pourrait mettre leur carrière en péril.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Girlfriend of the Year
programme.desc: Chris et Gail découvrent une voiture accidentée correspondant à une alerte enlèvement. Une chasse à l'homme débute et l'interrogatoire des parents de l’enfant révèle des indices troublants.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: La tension est palpable entre Andy et Swarek, mais ils doivent mettre leurs sentiments de côté lorsqu'un transfert de prisonnier qui tourne mal finit en chasse à l'homme.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 To Serve or Protect
programme.desc: Le père d'Andy, ancien flic, pense avoir commis un crime durant un trou de mémoire dû à l'alcool, et en se penchant sur l'affaire, elle est confrontée à l'éventualité de l'envoyer en prison.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: C'est le jour de l'évaluation pour les recrues, qui vont connaître l'avenir réservé à leur carrière. Mais le meurtre d'une jeune fille bouleverse Andy qui songe à rendre son insigne.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lorsqu'une arrestation prématurée compromet une importante saisie de drogue, Andy tente de s'infiltrer avec Swarek. Mais un changement de plan radical met leur vie en danger.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: La vie d'Andy bascule quand elle reçoit une balle perdue lors d'une fusillade qui ôte la vie à une étudiante. En cherchant une explication, Andy entre en conflit avec une nouvelle détective.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy et Gail jouent les serveuses afin de démanteler un trafic de drogue, Traci lutte contre ses sentiments pour Jerry, et Dov et Chris entrent en désaccord concernant une plainte.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Alors qu'ils enquêtent sur un vol de têtes coupées, Andy et Swarek retrouvent la trace d'un homme mentalement instable, et exposent malencontreusement Luke à de terribles conséquences.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Une série d'incendies frappe une laverie. Chris et Gail rencontrent un homme lié au passé de Chris, Traci interroge une jeune incendiaire, et Andy se retrouve piégée dans les flammes.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Un criminel donne une info qui pousse Dov et Chris dans une maison piégée. Traci et Andy font ce qu'elles peuvent pour une suspecte SDF. Luke et Jo travaillent ensemble sur une surveillance.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Un informateur est retrouvé assassiné. Andy fait équipe avec l'inspectrice Jo Rosati, qui semble bien intéressée par Luke. Gail doit protéger un jeune témoin qui cache un lourd secret.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S02 : E07 The One That Got Away
programme.desc: Une femme est agressée à l'identique qu'une recrue décédée, et Luke Callaghan est sûr qu'il s'agit du même suspect. Mais comme on lui retire l'affaire, il convainc Andy de suivre sa théorie.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: La 15e Division est sous quarantaine. Andy et Swarek cherchent le complice d'un braqueur. Gail a été exposée à un malade, Chris infiltre une cellule et Dov a rendez-vous avec une démineuse.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Dov et Gail tentent d'empêcher un gang chinois d'assassiner un mouchard. Andy et Chris rejoignent les recrues de la 27ème Division lors d'un entraînement équin pour le moins compétitif.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: La traque d'un ravisseur mène la 15e Division sur les lieux d'un accident de voiture. Pendant qu'Andy s'occupe d'une femme coincée dans sa voiture, les autres agents poursuivent le fugitif.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lors d'une infiltration, Traci et Andy tombent sur une femme faisant une overdose, et Dov rencontre un vieil ami. Chris et Gail s'occupent d'un adolescent retrouvé ligoté dans un cimetière.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Gail se fait voler son uniforme. Swarek tente d'obtenir des informations d'un ancien membre de la police criminelle, mais son incapacité à rester éloigné d'Andy compromet l'opération.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Alors que Swarek est violemment interrogé par Jamie Brennan dans le sous-sol d'une ferme, les recrues aident Andy à résoudre un mystère qui pourrait révéler l'endroit où il se trouve.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S03 : E01 The First Day of the Rest of Your Life
programme.desc: Alors qu'elle se rend à son audience, Andy, toujours suspendue, fait le lien entre une jeune fille qui disparaît mystérieusement du lieu d'un accident et une ancienne affaire non résolue.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Alors que les lycées s'apprêtent à fermer pour l'été, une voiture de police armée est volée. Andy et Swarek recherchent un adolescent instable qui a agressé le père de sa petite amie.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Dov est témoin d'un vol et abat un jeune adolescent noir. A-t-il fait usage d'une force justifiable ? Quand la nouvelle se répand dans le quartier, les choses s'enveniment.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Une voiture remplie de jeunes filles percute un autre véhicule et tue la conductrice. Quand Jerry découvre que l'autre conducteur était mort avant l'accident, il retire l'affaire à Traci.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Alors qu'Andy se retrouve obligée de travailler en étroite collaboration avec sa mère qui l'a abandonnée, Swarek, Nick, Chris et Gail recherchent une mère de famille désespérée.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy et Swarek découvrent un SDF poignardé et un témoin surprenant : Izzy, la fille d'Oliver, âgée de 15 ans. Son implication pousse Oliver à la frontière entre son rôle de père et de flic.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un soi-disant médium veut aider la 15e Division à retrouver un témoin dans une affaire de crime organisé, les policiers se retrouvent confrontés à certaines vérités cachées.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lors d'une enquête sur une série de disparitions d'escort-girls, Gail part en infiltration. Mais Dov et Chris découvrent qu'il s'agit de l'œuvre d'un tueur qui pourrait s'en prendre à Gail.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Gail se fait enlever par un possible tueur en série. En suivant les pistes d'affaires similaires, les agents retrouvent les traces du meurtrier, mais sont contraints de faire un sacrifice.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un ordinateur de la police contenant des informations sensibles est volé, les recrues, encore choquées de la mort d'un des leurs, découvrent qu'un informateur risque d'être compromis.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Alors qu'ils enquêtent sur un prêtre menacé de mort par un trafiquant de drogue local, Andy and Nick réalisent que ses relations surprenantes risquent de les mener sur un terrain glissant.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lors d'une garde, un prisonnier braque une arme sur Chris. Alors que les affaires internes cherchent un coupable, les recrues cherchent le juste milieu entre dire la vérité et se soutenir.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un pédophile évadé lors d'un transfert enlève une jeune fille, Andy et Sam le traquent et se retrouvent dans un face-à-face mortel aboutissant à une véritable catharsis émotionnelle.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Après six mois d'infiltration, Andy et Nick disparaissent l’un après l'autre. Pendant ce temps, Sam Swarek et les autres agents mènent une enquête qui tourne vite à la mission de sauvetage.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Dès son retour, Andy travaille avec Swarek pour retrouver un ancien détenu, et réalise à quel point les choses ont changé depuis qu'elle s'est éloignée de son ancienne vie, il y a six mois.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy fait équipe avec la nouvelle petite amie de Swarek. Quand elles se retrouvent face à un homme hors de contrôle, leurs différences sont mises à l'épreuve et l'une d'elles doit faire feu.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S04 : E04 The Kids Are Not Alright
programme.desc: Andy rêve d'un long week-end bien mérité, mais lorsqu'elle découvre un adolescent dans le coffre d'une voiture, elle cherche à le convaincre qu'aucun chagrin d'amour ne dure éternellement.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy et Marlo se retrouvent mises en quarantaine alors que la 15e Division se mobilise pour nettoyer les rues d'une drogue contaminée avant qu'une épidémie mortelle ne s'abatte sur la ville.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Quand une jeune fille est portée disparue, la police découvre un lien avec une ancienne affaire délicate. Gail, elle, doit affronter ses pires peurs pour retrouver la jeune fille disparue.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Quand des ossements humains retrouvés rouvrent une enquête vieille de 15 ans, Swarek se rapproche de son ancien instructeur et devra décider s'il veut continuer à suivre ses traces ou non.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S04 : E08 For Better, for Worse
programme.desc: La 15e Division souhaite passer une journée facile avant le mariage de Frank et Noelle, mais les choses tournent mal quand un bus de personnes âgées est attaqué et que la mariée disparaît.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Quand le fils de Chris se fait enlever, la 15e Division met tout en œuvre pour le retrouver. Mais quand il est ramené à la maison, Chris fait face à une révélation difficile.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Une descente dans une plantation de cannabis débouche sur la première affaire d'homicide de Traci, pendant que Swarek, Oliver, Chris et Dov partent passer une journée entre hommes.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Quand un pédophile est retrouvé battu à mort, Andy découvre que Marlo enquêtait sur lui hors du travail. Avec Swarek, ils vont tenter de la couvrir tout en retrouvant le véritable agresseur.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Quand Andy et Chloe essuient les tirs d'un tireur embusqué, les agents de la 15e Division réalisent qu'ils doivent continuer à servir et à protéger la ville tout en étant pris pour cible.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S04 : E13 You Can See the Stars
programme.desc: Suite à une attaque ciblée contre la 15e Division, Andy, Swarek et leurs collègues doivent découvrir la vérité sur un ancien crime à temps pour sauver la vie à Oliver Shaw.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lors d'une nuit éprouvante, Andy et Dov essaient de se ressourcer dans un restaurant ciblé par des braqueurs, pendant que la 15e Division tente de limiter les dommages collatéraux.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S05 : E02 All By Her Selfie
programme.desc: Oliver est promu sergent-chef et Andy forme une nouvelle recrue, mais quand ils interviennent ensemble sur un homicide, il semble que cette dernière va représenter un sacré défi pour Andy.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S05 : E03 Heart Breakers, Money Makers
programme.desc: À l'approche de la Fite Nite, la 15e division doit faire de nombreuses saisies, mais Andy demande de l'aide à Nick pour éclaircir des aveux suspects concernant une maison de jeu illégale.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Quand une fusillade mène à la découverte d'un chef de gang exécuté, la 15e Division cherche à éviter qu'une guerre des gangs n'éclate. Andy et Duncan doivent protéger le seul témoin.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lors d'une infiltration, l'intérêt de Chris pour un trafiquant de drogue éveille les soupçons de Dov. Duncan fait des accusations contre Andy, qui décide d'aider Sam dans une sombre affaire.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S05 : E06 Two Truths and a Lie
programme.desc: Andy et Sam décident d'interroger une liste de détenus d'un pénitencier, tous associés au principal suspect du meurtre de Brian Gowdy. Mais l'un d'eux est Jay Swarek, le père de Sam.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S05 : E07 Deal with the Devil
programme.desc: Oliver prépare Andy à se défendre lors de l'audience de licenciement de Duncan, mais ce dernier avançant de nouvelles preuves, Oliver va compromettre son intégrité et son amitié avec Andy.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Le problème de dépendance de Chris atteint son paroxysme durant une enquête sur un cambriolage suspect qui révèlera un problème de famille dysfonctionnelle et qui les mettra en danger.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lors du déménagement d'un immeuble voué à être détruit, Andy et Chloe découvrent un homme torturé dans un appartement vide, et dévoilent une opération criminelle de grande envergure.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Duncan reprend du service et souhaite se réconcilier avec Andy, qui n'est pas prête. Mais quand une bombe explose dans le centre-ville, la 15e Division doit en arrêter l'auteur au plus vite.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: La 15e Division s'efforce de retrouver Ted Mcdonald, l'auteur de l'attentat à la voiture piégée. Une fois attrapé, ils réalisent qu'il a dispersé d'autres bombes dans la nature.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Un mois après l'attentat à la bombe, Andy et Sam reprennent le travail. Mais quand Andy est agressée, la brigade des mœurs entre en conflit avec la 15e Division sur la manière de procéder.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Avec la grossesse de Marlo, Andy remet en doute son avenir avec Sam, mais son idée de la famille parfaite est remise en question quand elle rencontre une ado à la famille conservatrice.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Lors d'un transfert, une émeute éclate dans une prison pour femmes. Andy et Juliet se retrouvent alors prises au piège avec une détenue qui veut à tout prix prouver son innocence.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Quand le frère de Nick apparaît avec des informations sur une personne de leur passé, Nick décide de traquer l'homme en question, mais Juliet est sur ses talons.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: La 15e Division craint qu'un célèbre trafiquant d'armes n'ait kidnappé Traci, mais quand Andy réalise que c'est l'œuvre du violeur en série qui leur a échappé, tout le monde est mobilisé.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Après une fusillade lors d'un match de baseball, la relation entre Gail et son frère est mise à l'épreuve. Pendant ce temps, Swarek planifie une escapade avec Andy, qui s'avère surprenante.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy et Sam sont choqués d'apprendre qu'Oliver est le principal suspect d'une affaire de corruption au sein de la 15e Division, et n'ont que jusqu'à la fin de la journée pour le disculper.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Alors qu'Oliver est toujours le principal suspect de l'attentat à la bombe, Andy, Dov, Gail et Nick entreprennent un plan risqué pour prouver que le commissaire Alonso Santana est corrompu.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Une vague de chaleur frappe la ville, et le commissariat sert de station de rafraîchissement au public. Andy et Marlo recherchent une patiente disparue quand Marlo commence à accoucher.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.sub-title: S05 : E21 Breaking Up the Band
programme.desc: Andy vit mal l'arrivée de la fille de Sam et Marlo, et songe accepter une mission de quatre mois hors de la ville. Pendant ce temps, Jarvis annonce que la 15e Division va être restructurée.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Le jour de son mariage avec Sam, Andy découvre un homme mourant sur la route, sans possibilité d'appeler qui que ce soit. Parviendra-t-elle à le sauver et à se rendre à son mariage à temps ?

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Le triomphe se transforme en humiliation lorsqu'une opération tourne mal et qu'Andy McNally, nouvelle recrue de la police, arrête l'un des siens et ruine une opération d'infiltration.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Alors que les autres se lancent à la recherche d'un détenu, Swarek parle à Andy de ses exploits. Alors qu'ils se lancent à la poursuite d'un informateur danger, et une étincelle jaillit.

programme.title: Rookie Blue

programme.desc: Mai has rebounded from her previous loss to Joey to become a better duelist. Has Yugi learned from his loss to Kaiba, or is the emotional defeat still weighing on his heart? The answer is in the cards!

programme.desc: Joey frantically searches for the card that permits him to enter the final battle, not realizing Bandit Keith has stolen it from him. As he struggles to accept the fact that Serenity will be blind forever, he receives help from a new, and unexpected, friend!

programme.desc: Joey frantically searches for the card that permits him to enter the final battle, not realizing Bandit Keith has stolen it from him. As he struggles to accept the fact that Serenity will be blind forever, he receives help from a new, and unexpected, friend!

programme.desc: The two-faced Board of Directors of KaibaCorp trap Kaiba inside a virtual reality game! Mokuba recruits Yugi and Joey to free Kaiba from this ultimate game where losing equals death!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The quest for Kaiba continues with a little help from… Mai? But can Yugi and friends adapt to a virtual world where the rules and strategies keep changing every step of the way?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and friends rescue Kaiba, but they are still stuck in the game! The only exit is past Five-Headed Dragon, but in the difficult duel, Joey, Mokuba, and Mai lose all their life points! Can Yugi and Kaiba, two former opponents, work together and face the biggest enemy of their lives?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E46 Dungeon Dice Monsters, Part 1
programme.desc: A new student, Duke Devlin, defeats Joey in a game of Duel Monsters, forcing Joey to become his servant. Duke forces Joey to wear a dog costume and humiliates him in public, forcing Yugi to challenge Duke to a duel. However, this will not be a Duel Monsters duel, but a new game named Dungeon Dice Monsters!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E47 Dungeon Dice Monsters, Part 2
programme.desc: In exchange for Joey’s freedom, Yugi agrees to give up Duel Monsters forever if he loses. Unfamiliar with the rules, Yugi gets off to a rough start. His chances do not improve as Duke reveals that he designed Dungeon Dice Monsters with Pegasus’s aid! Can Yugi learn the new complex rules, much less form a strategy, before he is soundly defeated?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E48 Dungeon Dice Monsters, Part 3
programme.desc: Yugi uses his innate gaming skills to turn the tables on Duke, but Duke has one more rule to mention: All creatures take up territory on the grid-like board. With no room to summon any new monsters, Yugi’s position is helpless!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E49 Dungeon Dice Monsters, Part 4
programme.desc: After Duke’s all-powerful Orgoth the Relentless dices Yugi’s entire cadre of monsters into shreds, Yugi only has one turn left before he loses all his heart points! Yugi’s last hope rests in one final dice roll in the thrilling conclusion to Dungeon Dice Monsters!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E01 The Mystery Duelist, Part 1
programme.desc: An arcane fortune teller steals the Millennium Puzzle, and Yugi must defeat him in a duel to win it back! However, this is no ordinary soothsayer; he’s a familiar and formidable foe from Duelist Kingdom… or is he? Can Yugi beat him all alone without the help of his friends or the spirit inside the Puzzle?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E02 The Mystery Duelist, Part 2
programme.desc: The mysterious menace controlling Bandit Keith shatters the Millennium Puzzle into pieces before setting the dueling arena ablaze! Can Yugi put the Millennium Puzzle back together and save the spirit before the entire room is engulfed in flames?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E03 The Past Is Present
programme.desc: The origin of Duel Monsters is revealed! Using the magic of the Millennium Necklace, Egyptian historian Ishizu Ishtar shows Kaiba how Duel Monsters was played millenniums ago! The ancient games have resurrected in modern times, along with three almighty beasts of unstoppable devastation – the Egyptian God Monsters!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The spirit of the Millennium Puzzle realizes that his memories of ancient Egypt have faded, but Téa is going to help him uncover the mysteries of his past! However, their search is interrupted by the dancing duelist Johnny Steps and his musical monsters of rock!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: To face the future, Yugi must first look into the past! Yugi learns that he was a powerful Pharaoh who saved the world five thousand years ago, and he must now save the world again! Meanwhile, Kaiba tests the hidden powers of his Egyptian God Card Obelisk the Tormentor against the fury of Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E06 Stalked by the Rare Hunters
programme.desc: Joey is cornered by a group of sinister Rare Hunters who force Joey into a duel where if Joey loses, the Rare Hunters get his precious Red-Eyes B. Dragon! Though Joey pummels his foes with his mighty monster armada, eliminating life points isn’t the only path to victory…

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E07 Yugi vs. Rare Hunter, Part 1: Battle City Begins
programme.desc: It’s time to master new rules and monsters; let the Battle City Tournament commence! In the first duel of the tournament, Yugi challenges the Rare Hunter to win back Joey’s Red-Eyes B. Dragon. However, Yugi’s falling into the same trap that led to Joey’s demise!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E08 Yugi vs. Rare Hunter, Part 2: Up Against Exodia
programme.desc: Yugi figures out the Rare Hunter’s strategy to summon the almighty Exodia, but it’s too late to stop him! The Rare Hunter already has four pieces of Exodia in his hand, and the fifth and final piece is on top of his deck! How can Yugi stop the unstoppable Exodia?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E09 The ESP Duelist, Part 1
programme.desc: The psychic duelist Espa Roba defeats Rex Raptor as easy as a chumpasaurus, and Joey’s next on his hit list! What chance does Joey have when Espa Roba has the telepathic ability to read all the cards in Joey’s hand?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E10 The ESP Duelist, Part 2
programme.desc: Joey discovers that Espa Roba’s extrasensory perception is a hoax, but he’s not yet free from Espa's mental manipulations! Espa Roba’s Jinzo not only slaughters all of Joey’s monsters, but it grows in power every turn! Joey’s luck has come to an end… or has it?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E11 The Master of Magicians, Part 1
programme.desc: The magician duelist Arkana transports Yugi to the world’s most lethal dueling arena where the loser gets sent to the Shadow Realm! Yugi must win this duel or he'll lose much more than his Dark Magician!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E12 The Master of Magicians, Part 2
programme.desc: It’s Dark Magician versus Dark Magician! However, while Yugi only controls one Dark Magician, Arkana has three residing in his deck! Though outnumbered, Yugi will never give up, as long as he believes in the heart of the cards!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E13 The Master of Magicians, Part 3
programme.desc: To counter Arkana’s Dark Magician, Yugi pulls a rabbit out of his hat: Dark Magician Girl! It’s the battle of the sexes to determine the true master of magicians!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E14 Playing With a Parasite, Part 1
programme.desc: The trickster Weevil Underwood spins a web of lies to bait Joey into a lopsided duel! Weevil secretly infests Joey’s deck with a parasite that prevents Joey from summoning strong monsters! Without the support of his most powerful beasts, what chance does Joey have against a monster that even Yugi didn’t dare face at Duelist Kingdom: Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth!?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E15 Playing With a Parasite, Part 2
programme.desc: Joey swats Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth only to have Weevil let loose the ferocious Insect Queen, the crown jewel of insects that grows in strength for every creepy crawler it cannibalizes! Will Weevil’s royal ravager swarm Joey into submission?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi faces off against another of Marik’s nefarious Rare Hunters – the silent but deadly Strings! Strings stops all of Yugi’s attacks with Revival Jam, a slippery slime that resurrects whenever it’s destroyed! How can Yugi win if he can’t even put a dent in Strings’s life points?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Strings summons one of the most powerful creatures in the history of Duel Monsters... the Egyptian God Monster Slifer the Sky Dragon! What chance does Yugi’s band of mortal monsters have against an Egyptian God?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The spell Infinite Cards allows Strings to hold an unlimited number of cards in his hand, so Strings’s Slifer the Sky Dragon can grow to infinite attack power! Can Yugi discover Slifer’s one fatal flaw before he’s annihilated by tens of thousands of attack points?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey squares off against the sea duelist Mako Tsunami and his bevy of underwater beasts! If Joey wins, he’ll have all six Locator Cards necessary to enter the Battle City Finals, but if he loses, he can kiss the finals goodbye! However, little does Joey realize that he has bigger problems than this duel; the Rare Hunters are closing in on his location…

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Mako’s oceanic warrior The Legendary Fisherman unleashes a wave of destruction by stealthily destroying Joey’s monsters from the depths of the sea! Joey has to put his skills, training and experience to the ultimate test before he’s all washed out!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E21 Double Duel, Part 1: Yugi and Kaiba Vs. Lumis and Umbra
programme.desc: Abductions abound! Marik, with the help of Bakura, kidnaps Joey and Téa! To make matters worse, the Rare Hunters also kidnap Mokuba to force Yugi and Kaiba to take on tag team duelists Umbra and Lumis on top of a skyscraper! The losers will be sent plummeting into the Shadow Realm!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E22 Double Duel, Part 2: Yugi and Kaiba Vs. Lumis and Umbra
programme.desc: Lumis and Umbra systematically dismantle Yugi and Kaiba’s tumultuous teamwork! Can Yugi and Kaiba learn to put their differences aside before they’re sent on a one-way trip into the Shadow Realm?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E23 Double Duel, Part 3: Yugi and Kaiba Vs. Lumis and Umbra
programme.desc: Yugi and Kaiba start to exhibit signs of teamwork, but it’s too little too late when Umbra and Lumis summon Masked Beast Des Gardius, a monstrous menace even more powerful than Blue-Eyes White Dragon!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E24 Double Duel, Part 4: Yugi and Kaiba Vs. Lumis and Umbra
programme.desc: Yugi combines his magnetic monsters into the polar powerhouse Valkyrion the Magna Warrior! However, little does Yugi know that Umbra and Lumis have one final mask to turn Yugi’s monsters against him…

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and Kaiba are on a rescue mission to save their friends! But along the way, all their worries and secrets are revealed as they relive the troubles they’ve faced… and will be facing in the future!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E26 Friends 'Til the End, Part 1
programme.desc: It’s friend vs. friend as Marik mind controls Joey to duel against Yugi! The loser will be dragged into the ocean to sleep with the fishes! Can Yugi break Joey out of his spell, or will Joey break Yugi?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E27 Friends 'Til the End, Part 2
programme.desc: Though Joey decimates Yugi’s life points, Yugi can’t bring himself to attack his dear friend! Yugi summons Joey’s favorite monster Red-Eyes B. Dragon to try to bring Joey back to his senses. Will seeing his favorite card help Joey break Marik’s spell, or is Yugi’s last ditch effort a lost cause?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E28 Friends 'Til the End, Part 3
programme.desc: Yugi starts to break Marik’s spell over Joey, but he now must duel without the Millennium Puzzle! When Joey draws the card he needs to decimate Yugi’s life points, what chance does Yugi have, especially on his own?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E29 Friends 'Til the End, Part 4
programme.desc: There’s only one minute left in the duel before the loser is sent plummeting to the depths of the sea! Will these best friends actually send each other to their doom? However, there may be a special savior who just regained her eyesight…

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E30 Shadow of a Duel
programme.desc: It’s the battle of the ghouls as Bakura unleashes his army of ghosts against Bonz’s zealous zombies for the right to enter the Battle City Finals! But for whom will the final bell toll when this duel is played in the Shadow Realm…

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: It’s the game of love as Hollywood heartthrob Jean-Claude Magnum challenges Mai to a duel in order to win her hand in marriage! Will Mai succumb to Jean-Claude’s charm, not to mention his cadre of ninja monsters, or will she send him packing back to Tinseltown?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E32 Let the Finals Begin!
programme.desc: Let the Battle City Finals begin! The eight finalists will have their skill and endurance put to the ultimate test in a dueling arena thousands of feet in the sky! Yugi and friends finally meet the other finalists, but none of them are who they appear to be…

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E33 The Dark Spirit Revealed: Yugi Vs. Bakura, Part 1
programme.desc: It’s the first duel of the Battle City Finals as Yugi squares off against the evil spirit of the Millennium Ring that's possessing Bakura! Yugi quickly dispatches Bakura’s grotesque ghouls, but Bakura has a sinister strategy straight from the graveyard…

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E34 The Dark Spirit Revealed: Yugi Vs. Bakura, Part 2
programme.desc: Bakura activates Destiny Board, which will cause Yugi to lose automatically in five turns! If that’s not bad enough, Bakura’s Dark Sanctuary damages Yugi’s life points every time Yugi attacks! Unable to attack and running out of time, Yugi’s trapped!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E35 The Dark Spirit Revealed: Yugi Vs. Bakura, Part 3
programme.desc: Yugi’s Slifer the Sky Dragon is about to unleash the final blow to win the duel, but Bakura may not survive the blast from the almighty Egyptian God Monster! Will Yugi attack and advance in the finals, or will he surrender to save Bakura’s life but lose the only chance to protect the world from Marik’s evil?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S02 : E69 A Trio's Challenge - Part 1
programme.desc: Kite, Shark and Yuma join forces to take down Dr. Faker! Can this trio work together as a team and put an end to Faker’s fury, or will Faker and his deck prove to be too much of a challenge for these three fearless friends?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S02 : E70 A Trio's Challenge - Part 2
programme.desc: With the fate of Astral World hanging in the balance, Yuma, Kite and Shark set their sights on stopping Dr. Faker, but before our three heroes can make their final move, Dr. Faker reveals the shocking reason behind his diabolical plan!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S02 : E71 A Trio's Challenge - Part 3
programme.desc: When a mysterious being from Barian World appears, Yuma, Kite and Shark must work together and battle like never before if they want to save Hart, Astral World… and themselves!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The stage is set for the ultimate battle between Yuma and Kite, but just when Yuma’s about to high five the sky, Kite brings him crashing down to earth with a startling revelation!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The back and forth battle between Kite and Yuma comes to an exciting conclusion that leaves one of our duelists down for the count! Will Yuma’s dream of pulling out a victory become a reality, or is Kite going to turn this dream into a nightmare?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S02 : E74 Attack of the Barians - Part 1
programme.desc: The Barian invasion begins! Yuma faces a dangerous new enemy who will go to any extreme to gain possession of Yuma’s Numbers in order to destroy Astral and his home!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S02 : E75 Attack of the Barians - Part 2
programme.desc: Yuma’s battle with a dangerous and powerful soldier of Barian World continues as he strives to keep Astral safe! Can Yuma beat this Barian enemy and his new Chaos Monster, or will Yuma end up losing what is most valuable to him… Astral?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: When pro duelist Devon Knox teaches a special class, Yuma gets taken to the school of hard knocks and learns a valuable lesson about the Barians he won’t soon forget!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Ray nominates Yuma to run against Caswell for the position of Class Representative, but when the Ray Way takes a turn for the worse, Yuma finds himself facing off against a Student Council President who’s been corrupted by the Barians!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S02 : E78 The Adventures of Artimus Stanleyus
programme.desc: Shark gets hooked into a battle with the Barians when the President of the Comic Book Appreciation Club challenges him to a duel! Can Shark outdraw the competition, or will his Number and life points be erased?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Shark’s sister Rio makes a big splash on her first day at school, but not all the attention she gets is good, especially when she catches the eye of a Barian botanist!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S02 : E80 Rivals in the Ring
programme.desc: A new Barian threat arrives on the scene looking to take Yuma’s Numbers, but his plan gets tripped up when he falls head over heels for Tori!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E36 Rage of the Egyptian Gods
programme.desc: The origin of the Egyptian God Cards is finally revealed! The mysterious Shadi takes Yugi on a journey back in time to the creation of Duel Monsters… and the dangerous powers it released!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E37 Awakening of Evil, Part 1
programme.desc: In the second duel of the Battle City Finals, Odion, disguised as Marik, befuddles Joey with numerous traps to bring the duel to a stalemate. However, Joey has Giant Trunade, the perfect counter to Odion’s strategy that guarantees Joey victory… or is Joey falling into another trap?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E38 Awakening of Evil, Part 2
programme.desc: Odion’s Embodiments of Apophis run roughshod over Joey’s monsters… and his life points! Can Joey effectively utilize the monsters he won earlier in the tournament, or is he already too flustered to mount a successful counterattack?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E39 Awakening of Evil, Part 3
programme.desc: It’s a feeding frenzy as Odion’s Serket devours Joey’s monsters to morph into greater and powerful stages of evolution! How can Joey defeat Serket when it ingests Joey’s monsters whenever they’re summoned on to the field?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E40 Awakening of Evil, Part 4
programme.desc: Odion uses a phony Egyptian God Card to summon the third Egyptian God Monster The Winged Dragon of Ra and targets it to annihilate the rest of Joey’s life points! However, is Odion able to control the ultimate power of an Egyptian God, or will The Winged Dragon of Ra punish all those unworthy of summoning it?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E41 Mind Game: Mai Vs. Marik, Part 1
programme.desc: The third duel of the Battle City Finals between Mai and Marik is no ordinary duel; it’s a battle in the dreaded Shadow Realm where losing life points equals losing your memories! As Marik’s true sinister self comes to the surface, does Mai stand a chance against this malevolent evil?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E42 Mind Game: Mai Vs. Marik, Part 2
programme.desc: As Mai loses more and more of her memories under Marik’s relentless assault, she loses confidence in her dueling abilities. Will Yugi and friends’ neverending support bring her back to victory, or will her shattered mind be trapped in the Shadow Realm for eternity?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E43 Mind Game: Mai Vs. Marik, Part 3
programme.desc: Mai gains control of Marik’s The Winged Dragon of Ra, but she’s unable to decipher how to unleash its massively powerful abilities! Can Mai solve the mystery of the Egyptian God Card before Marik solves it himself and incinerates Mai with the full fury of The Winged Dragon of Ra?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E44 A Duel With Destiny: Kaiba Vs. Ishizu, Part 1
programme.desc: In the fourth duel of the Battle City Finals, Kaiba’s mystery opponent is… Ishizu! With the power of her Millennium Necklace, Ishizu can see the future, including every card Kaiba is planning to play! Does Kaiba stand a chance against an opponent who knows his moves even before he does?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E45 A Duel With Destiny: Kaiba Vs. Ishizu, Part 2
programme.desc: Ishizu, using the magic of her Millennium Necklace, has already seen the outcome of the duel – she will defeat Kaiba with her trap! How can Kaiba win when it’s already destined that he will lose? It’s time for Kaiba to change the future!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: As Marik’s evil grows, Ishizu reveals the secrets of her bloodline: How did Marik transform from a kind child into a power-hungry tyrant out for world domination? Can Yugi save Marik from the edge of darkness, or is he already beyond salvation?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E47 Showdown in the Shadows: Marik Vs. Bakura, Part 1
programme.desc: With their previous pact broken, Bakura duels Marik for the right to control the Millennium Rod and the Millennium Ring, and the loser will be trapped inside the Shadow Realm forever! To tip the odds, Bakura gains an unexpected ally in the form of… another Marik?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S02 : E48 Showdown in the Shadows: Marik Vs. Bakura, Part 2
programme.desc: Bakura and good Marik summon The Winged Dragon of Ra, ready to blast and banish evil Marik into the Shadow Realm! But The Winged Dragon of Ra has more than one special ability, and evil Marik knows how to use them all!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: As Kaiba’s blimp speeds towards KaibaCorp Island for the final rounds of the Battle City Tournament, the ship is hijacked by a mysterious boy named Noah and his henchmen – five familiar foes from Yugi and Kaiba’s past who are out for revenge! With the power of cyberspace on Noah’s side, Yugi and friends are trapped inside a new and dangerous Duel Monsters game!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E02 Isolated in Cyber Space — Part 1"
programme.desc: Noah displays the power of his virtual world by splitting up Yugi’s gang and flinging them into the far reaches of his self-created universe! The first to duel under the all-new Deck Master System is Yugi against Big 1 Gansley’s Deepsea Warrior! Can Yugi master the complex new rules, or will the rules master him?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E03 Isolated in Cyber Space — Part 2
programme.desc: Yugi faces off against Gansley, in the form of "Deepsea Warrior", but struggles with the complexities of the dueling field and the new rules. Tea faces peril from a vicious tribe of cyclopses while Kaiba and Mokuba are brought to a setting similar to their old orphanage.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E04 Isolated in Cyber Space — Part 3
programme.desc: Yugi's strategy is hindered by Gansley's Deck Master ability. Tristan and Duke face a mean dinosaur to save Serenity. Meanwhile, Kaiba and Mokuba confront painful visions of their miserable childhood, but within the heartache may lurk the key to Noah's true intentions.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Téa is led by a penguin to Crump, in the form of Nightmare Penguin, who challenges her to a duel. She learns immediately that dueling in the virtual realm differs starkly from her previous duels, and starts to succumb to the virtual playing field.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Despite gaining a lead with Maha Vailo, Téa falls behind as Crump begins an assault on her life points, causing the ice around her to grow. With the help of her Deck Master, Dark Magician Girl, and Yugi's Dark Magician, Téa gains enough confidence to win.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey faces the Big 5's lawyer, Johnson, in a courtroom duel. Joey pulls an early lead with his Deck Master, Flame Swordsman, but Johnson's Deck Master, Judge Man, has abilities of his own.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey attempts to pull through with several luck-based cards, but Johnson's cheating tactics ruin all his chances, until an angry Noah puts a stop to him.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Tristan, Duke and Serenity duel Nesbitt, the Big 5's mechanical expert. Serenity's lack of experience with the game and Nesbit's powerful machine monsters create a tragic end for Tristan.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: With Tristan gone and Serenity in shock, Duke attempts to defeat Nesbitt by himself. But when Orgoth the Relentless is destroyed by his Perfect Machine King, Duke tries to help Serenity regain confidence in her abilities. The two later remember Tristan's face down card, hoping it will help them win.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E11 Settling the Score — Part 1
programme.desc: As Nesbitt (in Tristan's body) kidnaps Mokuba, Kaiba is forced to duel Lector, the former assistant to his stepfather. For Lector, the duel is personal, as he plans to take what he believes is rightfully his—KaibaCorp. Meanwhile, Tristan rejoins the group; his friends do not recognize him, since his mind has been downloaded into a mechanical monkey.

Lance and wish him dead. Much to their chagrin, the men recognize that Lance's survival...

After waiting for the agreed time, Andrew is miffed to realize that Diane is still not ready for babies and wants to wait another five years. This causes Andrew to consider a drastic approach to try to change Diane’s mind.

Other fine actors in the cast include the always popular Bryant Washburn and a young Bob Steele, who appears under his real name Bob Bradbury Jr. The story takes place in the 1860s or 1870s near Spirit Lake, Iowa. Settlements of whites are growing in that region but the Sioux Indians also have professed their interest in one such settlement. Chief Sitting Bull surveys the...

programme.desc: Waiting to hear whether or not gold has been struck in the mine, Annie discovers a beloved stagecoach is being driven by the daughter of the owner, whos threatening to sell the stage so he can pocket the money. programme.desc: After Adam gets hurt while saving a woman from a group of indians, the woman must nurse Adam back to health as the rest of the tribe sets out to find her.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: What happens when Abraham Lincoln himself comes to New Mexico to discuss a treaty with Native American chief Acoma (Ted de Corsia)? Can the hotbed of emotions be quieted by cavalry Captain Hunt (Lew Ayres)? Or will the Captains superiors insist on provoking with the native tribe? Find out what happens in this fictional tale packed with action from 1951!

programme.title: Texas Brooklyn and Heaven
programme.desc: When Eddie Tayloe (Guy Madison, 5 Against the House) receives $6,000 from his grandfather, he decides to leave his drab newspaper job and move to New York. His dream is to have a play produced on Broadway. Along the way he picks up a pretty hitchhiker (Diana Lynn, The Miracle of Morgan's Creek) who is also leaving her own dreary life for a shot at New York. Unfortunately, they find that the Big Apple is a hard place to make a living. But it's also a city where circumstances keep bringing them together!

programme.title: Tumbleweeds
programme.desc: The great William S. Hart stars in this classic tale of settlers in the Oklahoma territory. Directed by King Baggot, one of the most versatile movie figures of the silent era, this movie is not only history recorded in heart throbs, as the original print ads boasted, but shows us why Hart is considered by some to be the top western actor of them all. Hart, who directed many of his own films, also had a hand in directing this feature, which turned out to be his last starring role.

programme.title: Rawhide
programme.desc: Baseball superstar Gehrig is one of several ranchers being coerced by a bunch of bandits. His sister and her lawyer/lover organize the ranchers. Directed by Ray Taylor; starring Smith Ballew, Gehrig, Evelyn Knapp. Talk about stunt casting! Gehrig was a New York Yankees star who was nearing the end of his career, but one of the biggest sports stars in the country. In the movie he plays a variation of himself, as Lou Gehrig, a retired baseball player who takes up ranching. Lou expects to relax on his ranch but quickly joins other ranchers in a fight to protect their properties.

programme.title: Blue Steel
programme.desc: Undercover US Marshal John Carruthers (John Wayne) is investigating a rash of robberies by a character known as The Polka Dot Bandit in this B-movie gem. Along the way, Carruthers finds himself in more trouble than he'd ever expected! Written and directed by Robert N. Bradbury, the film features George Gabby Hayes, Eleanor Hunt, and many other favorites of the era. Wayne was only 27 at the time of Blue Steel, but was well on his way to becoming The Duke.

programme.title: Santa Fe Trail
programme.desc: Oscar winner Michael Curtiz (Casablanca, Mildred Pierce) directed this exciting drama about Army officer Jeb Stuart and the days leading up to the Civil War. Errol Flynn (The Adventures of Robin Hood) stars as Stuart, with Olivia de Havilland as his romantic interest (the seventh of nine times they were paired together by Warner Bros.) The cast includes Ronald Reagan as General George Custer, and Raymond Massey as John Brown, with such familiar faces as Alan Hale and Van Hefflin in supporting roles. Filmed partly in Santa Fe!

programme.title: Riders of the Whistling Skull
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers appeared in several Republic Pictures during the 1930s, and this is considered one of their best. It's about a mysterious murder at an archeological expedition, which leads the three prairie pals into some dangerous territory. Can they solve the murder without losing their own lives? The cast includes Robert Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune, and Roger Williams, all trying to survive a hail of poison arrows and hot lead!

programme.title: The Devil Horse
programme.desc: When a boy is captured by a Native American tribe after his family is massacred, he finds solace in befriending a wild colt. Years later, following his escape, he is recaptured by a tribe who force him to battle their vicious devil horse. Yet, the horse looks familiar. Is this mysterious devil horse and the wild colt he knew years earlier one and the same? Produced by Hal Roach, who wrote the script with an assist from Stan Laurel, this little treasure was the fourth of 15 features to star Rex the Wonder Horse!

programme.title: Bulldog Courage
programme.desc: Tim McCoy, one of the unsung heroes of 1930s western pictures, stars in a dual role. First, hes Slim Braddock, a miner who turns to robbing stagecoaches after being swindled by a banker. When Slim is murdered, his son Tim, also played by McCoy, seeks vengeance. Directed by B-movie legend Sam Newfield for Excelsior Pictures, this film is a showcase for McCoy, who appeared in more than 90 movies and in 1960 earned a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame!

programme.title: Fast Bullets
programme.desc: Tom Tyler stars in this vintage western from the short-lived Reliable Pictures Company, a group known for low budgets and lots of action. In this feature, Tom reforms a gang member in order to infiltrate a ring of thieves. Rex Lease, Margaret Nearing, and Al Bridge also star.

programme.title: Hellgate (Edited Version)
programme.desc: In 1867 Kansas, veterinarian Sterling Hayden treats an injured stranger who turns out to have been a guerrilla raider--and Hayden soon finds himself serving a term in one of the world's most terrifying prisons under sadistic commandant Ward Bond. Adapted from the story of Dr. Mudd, the physician who attended John Wilkes Booth, assassin of President Lincoln.

programme.title: Fugitive of the Plains

Helmed by famed B-movie director Sam Newfield, this film also features Al St. John, whose lovable Fuzzy character was as essential to the PRC's Billy the Kid series as Billy himself.

programme.desc: For at bevise sit værd risikerer en tidligere filmhelt alt. I sin kamp mod forskelige kritikere, et alter ego, sin datter og en skuespiller stræber han efter at komme ud af middelmådigheden.

programme.title: The Motorcycle Diaries
programme.desc: Ernesto Guevara de la Serna, populært kendt som Che, beslutter sig sammen med sin ven Alberto Granado for at tage på en biltur gennem Sydamerika. Hans oplevelser på rejsen forandrer ham.

programme.title: Sommersby
programme.desc: Efter seks år som soldat i Den Amerikanske Borgerkrig vender en venligere og mere betænksom soldat hjem til sin gård og kone, som ellers troede, han var død. En skuffet bejler afslører, at manden er en bedrager, og at den rigtige Sommersby er efterlyst for mord.

programme.title: Undine
programme.desc: Christian Petzold er tilbage med en moderniseret version af den gamle kærlighedsfabel om vandvæsenet Undine, der først kan blive menneske, når hun forelsker sig i en mand, men som må dræbe ham og vende tilbage til sit element, vandet, hvis han ikke er hende tro.

programme.title: Joy Ride
programme.desc: To brødre på køretur gennem landet begår den fejl at lave en prank på en mentalt forvirret lastbilchauffør og betaler dyrt for spøgen, da han forvandler sig til en morderisk stalker.

programme.title: The Conversation
programme.desc: Baseret på en virkelig hændelse. I juni 1945 mødes to magtfulde mænd med stærkt modsatrettede filosofier og syn på deres lands fremtid.

programme.title: Break Point
programme.desc: Darren er i pengenød, mens Jimmy jagter tidligere tiders succes på tennisbanen, så de går sammen som makkere og gør et optimistisk forsøg på at kvalificere sig til en Grand Slam-turnering. Med komikerne Jeremy Sisto og Adam Devine samt den Oscar-vindende skuespiller J.K. Simmons

programme.title: Big Momma's House 2
programme.desc: FBI agenten Malcolm Turner (Lawrence) har nu skrivebordsjob, kone ogventer barn. Men da nationens sikkerhed står på spil, må Turner somBig Momma agere barnepige for tre møgunger.

programme.title: Never Too Late
programme.desc: Fire krigsveteraner, som har overlevet Vietnam-krigens fangelejre, beslutter sig for at gennemføre en sidste flugt – fra plejehjemmet. Men det byder på udfordringer at planlægge en flugt med en gruppe, der er ramt af senilitet.

programme.desc: Elliot Richards er en håbløs, ung mand, som er besat af at finde kærligheden. Desperat efter at ændre sit liv indgår han en pagt med Djævlen, som lover at gøre netop dette - men for en pris.

programme.title: Alright Now
programme.desc: En rockmusiker tilmelder sig universitetet efter at hun slår op med sin kæreste, og hendes band går i opløsning.

programme.title: Pushing Tin

programme.desc: I denne klassiske western er den berygtede og legendariske revolvermand Jack Beauregard (Henry Fonda) på jagt efter sin brors mordere. Han har sat sig for, at denne morderjagt skal blive afslutningen på en lang karriere.

programme.desc: Den seje dusørjæger Trinity (Terence Hill) beslutter at besøge sin halvbror Bambino (Bud Spencer), der ernærer sig som hestetyv og plattenslager.

programme.desc: En ensom enke har planlagt at rejse jorden rundt med sin mands aske for at besøge de steder, de faldt for i de forskellige film, de så sammen. Det første stop på rejsen forandrer hendes liv for altid.

Men bogen ender med at føre både hans eget liv og hele Hollywood ud i det rene kaos.

Og da han hyres til et job af en hemmelig religiøs sekt, føler han sig ikke parat til endnu en gang at påtage sig Ghost Riders flammende kræfter og magt. Men måske er dette den sidste mulighed for at gøre sig fri.

Da den kvindelige lejemorder Zeng Jing beslutter at trække sig tilbage og vie sit liv til at redde resterne af en mytologisk, buddhistisk munk, får hun et helt hold af mordere efter sig.

programme.desc: Jon, en ulykkeligt forelsket, men charmerende fiasko på nærmest alle punkter, Luke, en superkører på flugt fra fortiden, og Keira, medarbejder i en burgerrestaurant og veganeraktivist, kommer på kant af loven på deres tur gennem New Zealand i en ”lånt” gul Mini Cooper.

programme.title: Sahara
programme.desc: Opdagelsesrejsende Dirk Pitt med flere tager på det allerstørste eventyr, når de leder efter et jernbeklædt kampskib med hemmelig last i Vestafrika.

programme.desc: Splint; rotten sensei; fornemmer, at hans fire teenagere skildpadde-disciple er vokset fra hinanden og har brug for at knytte bånd for at besejre et gammelt monster.

programme.title: Elektra

programme.title: The Condemned 2

programme.title: Awake

programme.desc: En reporter motiveres til at ændre sit liv, efter at hun har interviewet en synsk hjemløs mand, der siger, at hendes liv ingen mening har og vil ende om få dage.

programme.title: Pete Smalls Is Dead
programme.desc: KC er fortvivlet, da lokale bøller stjæler hans hund og kræver at få de 10.000 dollars han skylder dem. Hans forhenværende bedste ven, Jack, fortæller at han har pengene...

programme.title: The Duchess
programme.desc: En krønike om livet for aristokraten Georgiana, hertuginde af Devonshire, fra det 18. århundrede, der var æret for sit ekstravagante politiske og personlige liv.

programme.title: Fantastic Mr. Fox
programme.desc: Animeret film med GEORGE CLOONEY og MERYL STREEP som Mr. og Mrs. Fox, der lever et lykkeligt familieliv med den excentriske søn (JASON SCHWARTZMAN) og nevøen Kristofferson, som er på besøg. Lige indtil Mr. Fox planlægger dyreverdenens største kyllingekup.

programme.title: Mama Weed
programme.desc: Da en underbetalt polititolk under en aktion opdager, at en af de involverede er en person i hendes nærhed, tager hun en skæbnesvanger beslutning.

programme.title: Death At A Funeral
programme.desc: For de fleste er begravelser bare noget, der skal overstås, og hvis det stod til Daniel, så sprang han gerne denne dag over, hvor hans far skal stedes til hvile.

programme.title: The Fountain
programme.desc: To udødelige, forbundne sjæle transcenderer tid og rum, som den ene desperat søger at redde den anden for at indfri et løfte om evigt liv.

programme.title: Tågesyn
programme.desc: André (32) og hans nye kæreste Elisa (35) venter barn og flytter ud på landet hvor Elisa er vokset op. Men i stedet for at bringe dem tættere, river graviditeten dem fra hinanden og forstyrrende hemmeligheder om Elisa begynder at vise sig under overfladen.

programme.title: Ariel
programme.desc: En minearbejder mister sit job og beslutter sig for at starte et nyt liv. Han møder en kvinde, og sammen forsøger de at finde lykken, men møder mange forhindringer på vejen.

programme.title: Pigen fra tændstikfabrikken
programme.desc: En kvinde, der arbejder på en tændstikfabrik, oplever en række uheldige hændelser, der fører til, at hun træffer en drastisk beslutning.

programme.title: Edison
programme.desc: En af politiets eliteenheder risikerer at blive afsløret i korruption af en ung journalist, som hurtigt opdager, at han er på dybt vand.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Ray Keene (John Cusack), en far, der ønsker at gøre oprør i sin søns (Jamie Andersons) øjne, forsøger at bringe Carden (Morgan Freeman), en snigmorder i verdensklasse, for retten. Hele tiden skal han beskytte sin søn og undgå snigmorderholdet, der metodisk jagter dem i vildmarken.

programme.title: Programmerne genoptages snart
programme.desc: Vi er ved at indhente vores skønhedssøvn! Bliv hængende for mere uvurderlig underholdning udvalgt af Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Saints Of War
programme.desc: Jersey, 1942. Da Hitler strammer grebet om Vesteuropa, bliver Kanaløerne besat. Tyskerne brugere Jersey som en base, hvor krigsfanger knokler i arbejdslejre, og indbyggerne står over for en fremtid fuld af usikkerhed og frygt.

programme.title: The Duchess
programme.desc: En krønike om livet for aristokraten Georgiana, hertuginde af Devonshire, fra det 18. århundrede, der var æret for sit ekstravagante politiske og personlige liv.

programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: De startede som et undergrundswebsite og blev verdens mest eftersøgte personer.

programme.title: Cha Cha Cha
programme.desc: Den alkoholiserede Matti, der bor under broerne, er ved at arve en betydelig sum penge fra sin amerikanske faster. Men manden skal se præsentabel ud under fasterens besøg. Matti fortæller sin ven, der arbejder som bilforhandler, om situationen, og han foreslår en rollebytte mod kompensation.

programme.title: Conviction
programme.desc: Da Bettys bror bliver dømt for mord, starter en 18 år lang kamp mod systemet. Overbevist om sin brors uskyld begynder Betty på jurastudiet, så hun selv vil kunne forsvare sin bror i retten!

programme.title: 200 Cigarettes
programme.desc: Det er nytårsaften i New York, og året er 1981. Monica skal holde fest, men ved 21-tiden er ingen dukket op. Hendes gæster er på vej, men de har ikke travlt. Kevin har ikke lyst til at fejre nytår, eftersom han lige er blevet dumpet. Val og Stephie farer vild og havner på en klub.

programme.title: Lang Historie Kort
programme.desc: Dette er fortællingen om Ellen og hendes venner, og deres mere eller mindre selvforskyldt komplicerede kærlighedsliv og romantiske drømme.

programme.title: Officer og spion
programme.desc: I 1895 anklages kaptajn Alfred Dreyfus (Louis Garrel), en ung og lovende officer, for spionage til tyskerne og dømmes til livsvarigt fængsel på Djævleøen. Dreyfus' ydmygelse følges også af Georges Picquart (Jean Dujardin), der er blevet forfremmet til at lede kontraespionagenheden.

programme.title: Elegy
programme.desc: Den aldrende litteraturprofessor David lever alene og har en forkærlighed for unge studerende. En dag møder han den smukke Consuela og forfører hende uden seriøse hensigter. Efterhånden uddybes deres forhold, og den gamle kyniker opdager pludselig, at han er forelsket.

programme.title: 9 1/2 uge (9½ Weeks)
programme.desc: En kvinde indleder et forhold til en mand, hun dårligt kender. Deres seksuelle eskapader fører til flere og flere forviklinger. Erotisk kultfilm med Oscar-vinderen Kim Basinger og Oscar-nominerede Mickey Rourke
